event_records.description: Jian Wei's email with the lease is in Margaret's inbox, sent Tuesday morning.

margaret_thornbury.name: Margaret Thornbury
margaret_thornbury.persona_brief:
You are Margaret Thornbury.
Margaret has signed and returned every document Jian Wei has sent her within a day. She told Jian Wei on Monday that she was ready to sign. She has a printer and scanner at home.

jian_wei_lim.name: Jian Wei Lim
jian_wei_lim.persona_brief:
You are Jian Wei Lim.
Jian Wei emailed the lease to Margaret on Tuesday morning. He expects her to sign and return it.

resolution.question: Will Margaret Thornbury send the signed lease back to Jian Wei Lim before the deadline at 5pm on Thursday? Jian Wei emailed the lease on Tuesday morning. Margaret has signed and returned every document Jian Wei has sent her within a day, told him on Monday that she was ready to sign, and has the printer and scanner she uses at home.
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Margaret actually sent the signed lease to Jian Wei before 2026-09-10T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
